rules.A11Y-IMG-ALT: an image has an alt attribute (an empty one marks it as decoration)
rules.A11Y-BUTTON-TYPE: a native button says its type, so it never submits a form by accident
rules.A11Y-CONTROL-NAME: a native input, select or textarea has a name: a label around it, a FormField around it, an id, aria-label, aria-labelledby or title
rules.A11Y-STATIC-CLICK: an element that is not interactive and has a click handler also has a role and a key handler
rules.A11Y-TABINDEX: tabIndex is never positive (it breaks the order of the page)
rules.A11Y-BLANK-REL: a link that opens a new tab says rel="noopener" (noreferrer implies it)
rules.A11Y-SVG-NAME: an inline svg is hidden from assistive technology or has a name
rules.A11Y-ANCHOR-HREF: an anchor has an href (otherwise it is a button)
rules.A11Y-OUTLINE-NONE: a stylesheet does not remove the focus outline without a visible replacement
rules.RSP-FIXED-WIDTH: an inline style does not fix a width of 600 px or more (a phone is 390 px wide)
rules.RSP-VIEWPORT-WIDTH: nothing is sized with 100vw (it ignores the scrollbar and overflows)
rules.RSP-VIEWPORT-META: the page has a device-width viewport that allows zoom, and a language
